book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Mak beleŋ Mere igiŋ Yesu niŋ yitiŋ kayyiŋ

content: Yesu kamyiŋde mat huwaryiŋ
Be, Yuda marte usaŋ nalu, Sabat go hubu hekeb Makdala niŋ Mariaya Yems miliŋ Mariayabe Salomeya gobe Yesu kamyiŋ hakwam goyen sam irtek yeŋ he fimiŋ kura hamiŋ igiŋ muŋ goyen damu tiyamiŋ.
Irdeb fay urke Sande wampot muŋ naŋa pirik irkeyabe horabok bembare kwamiŋ.
Kuŋ heŋyabe, “Horabok mohoŋ pet titiŋ hora kuruŋ gobe ganuŋ beleŋ kaŋ kaŋ irde siŋa ireŋ tiya?” yeŋ kadom gusuŋaŋ gird tiyamiŋ.
Gega hurkuŋ heŋyabe horabok bemba mohoŋde naŋkeneŋbe hora kuruŋ wor po goyen bikkeŋ teŋ siŋa irtiŋ kenamiŋ.
Gwahade keneŋbe kuŋ forok yeŋ horabok bana hurkuŋbe al foŋeŋ kura uliŋhor faykek manaŋ yase beleŋ mat keperde hike keneŋbe kafura hamiŋ.
Irkeb al goreb, “Kafura heŋ ma. Nasaret niŋ al Yesu kuruse hende mayke kamuŋ goke wayhaŋ gobe gar ma hi. Yeŋbe bikkeŋ huwara. Keraŋ gasuŋdebe hubu ga kennaŋ.
Niŋgeb kuŋbe komatmiŋya Pitaya yeneŋ momoŋ yirnaŋ. Yesube yiŋgeŋ yiyuŋ gwahade po, yeŋ wa meheŋ heŋ Galili kuyeŋ. Gor gab kennayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.

Irkeb bere gobe kafura heŋ barbar yeŋ kukuwamŋeŋ nurdeb horabok bemba bana mat kateŋ siŋare heŋbe busaharde kwamiŋ. Gega kafura heŋbe mata kenamiŋ goke al kura ma momoŋ yiramiŋ. Yesu beleŋ komatmiŋ hulyaŋ yirdeb Al Kuruŋ hitte hurkuriŋ [
Be, Yesu wampot muŋ huwaryiŋ goya goyen haŋkapyabe Makdala niŋ Maria diliŋde wa forok yiriŋ. Yeŋbe uŋgura 7 ketal urtiŋ hinhin goyen Yesu beleŋ sope irke igiŋ hiriŋ bere go goyen.
Be, bere go Yesu keneŋ mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋbe Yesu gama irde haŋyen marya Yesu kamyiŋ gote doloŋde heŋ eseŋ hinhan marya goyen momoŋ yiryiŋ.
Gega mel gobe bere gore, “Yesube kamuŋde mat huwara. Irke kenhem,” yinyiŋ go nurdeb fudinde yeŋ ma nuramiŋ.
Be, go kamereb Yesube komatmiŋ irawa kura Yerusalem tubul teŋ tiyuŋ hoyaŋde kuŋ hikeya al hoyaŋ yara heŋ yeŋ hitte forok yiriŋ.
Forok yeke keneŋ bebak teŋbe mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋ kadom yago momoŋ yiraryum. Gega yeŋbe irem gore yaryum goyen manaŋ fudinde yeŋ ma nuramiŋ.

Be, go kamereb Yesu yiŋgeŋ komatmiŋ 11 goyen ya bana heŋ dula teŋ hikeya forok yiriŋ. Forok yeŋbe al beleŋ huwaryiŋ kamere keneŋ momoŋ yirke ga tonaŋ tareŋ irde usi tahaŋ yeŋ nurde wasak po tiyamiŋ mar goyen goke yineŋ teŋ saba yiryiŋ.
Irdeb, “Kuŋ naŋa kuruŋ al hike kwa goyen bana ne niŋ yitiŋ mere igiŋ gayen tagalde momoŋ yirde tukunayiŋ.
Al kura baraŋ gayen fudinde yeŋ dufaymiŋ saŋiŋ irde baptais tenayiŋ mar gobe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ yumulgaŋ tiyyeŋ. Gega al gwaha ma tinayiŋ mar gobe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ merem yaŋ yiryeŋ.
Ne niŋ dufaymiŋ tareŋ irnayiŋ mar gobe Al Kuruŋyen tareŋde mata tiŋeŋ gahade teŋ hinayiŋ: deŋner uŋgura yakira teŋ hinayiŋ, naŋa hoyaŋde niŋ mere mat Al Kuruŋ mere irde hinayiŋ,

haniŋde kunere duwi yanarke yisinayiŋ gega go ma kamnayiŋ, fe det buluŋ miŋyaŋ nene kamtek goyen nenayiŋ gega go ma kamnayiŋ. Irdeb al gore garbam mar haniŋ yerde yuneŋ Al Kuruŋ gusuŋaŋ irkeb igiŋ henayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Be, Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ Yesu beleŋ mere yiryiŋ go kamereb Naniŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ tumulgaŋ tike hurkuŋ al deŋem yaŋ heŋ haniŋ yase beleŋ kipiryiŋ.

Be, go kamereb Yesuyen komatmiŋ beleŋ kuŋ yeŋ ge yitiŋ mere igiŋ goyen naŋa al hike kwa kuruŋ gayen bana tagalde tukamiŋ. Gwaha teŋ hikeyabe Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ komatmiŋya heŋ meteŋ teŋ mel gore mere teŋ hinhan goyen fudinde yeŋ nurd nurd niŋ teŋbe mata tiŋeŋ turŋuŋ yaŋ kurayen kurayen goyen manaŋ forok yirde hinhin.]
